CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   B. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
